fitAnalysis.assessment:
This is a weak fit (22%) for the Customer Success Manager role at Datadog.

**Strengths:**
- Curriculum design and workshop facilitation show structured onboarding ability
- Seven years teaching demonstrates sustained relationship management with stakeholders

**Gaps:**
- No customer account management or B2B sales experience
- No experience with upselling, cross-selling, or contract negotiation
- No renewal risk identification or SaaS adoption management experience

**Recommendation:** Before applying to CSM roles, build direct customer-facing experience, ideally through a junior account management or sales development role in a SaaS company, where your coaching and communication skills can transfer more directly.

coverLetter:
Daniel Okafor
Leeds, UK
daniel.okafor@example.org
+44 20 5550 0188

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

Datadog's customers need someone who can take a technically complex product and make its value immediately clear to the people using it. That's a problem I've spent eight years solving: as a physics teacher and Head of Year at Ashgrove Academy, I raised the share of students reaching their target grade from 71% to 86% by diagnosing where understanding broke down and fixing it, one conversation at a time.

The skills that drove that result translate directly to what Datadog needs in this role. Building trust with a group of stakeholders, tracking progress data to spot where things are going wrong before they become a crisis, and communicating clearly across very different levels of technical confidence are things I do every term. I run weekly calls and multiple parents' evenings each year for a year group of 210 students, coordinating across teachers, pastoral staff and senior leadership to keep everyone aligned. I also designed and delivered training for 12 colleagues on a new practical curriculum, which required me to listen carefully, adjust my approach to each person and follow up until the change stuck. That same discipline applies directly to helping customers build adoption and get genuine value from a platform like Datadog's.

I'd welcome the chance to talk through how my background fits the role. I'm available at your convenience and happy to arrange a call at short notice.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Customer Success Manager, Daniel Okafor
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Explaining complex technical ideas clearly and building trust with people who are new to them is what I have done for eight years, working with around 140 students and their families each year, and I think that translates directly to what Datadog needs in a Customer Success Manager. I raised Year 11 pass rates significantly by tracking progress carefully and adjusting how I communicated results to different audiences, which reflects the attention to detail and relationship-building your role calls for. My CV and cover letter are attached with more detail on my background. I am available from next week for a call at whatever time suits you.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor

followUpEmail.subject: Following Up: Customer Success Manager, Daniel Okafor
followUpEmail.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I applied last week for the Customer Success Manager role and wanted to follow up briefly.

The emphasis on partnering with sales to deliver smooth onboarding caught my attention, as that kind of cross-functional coordination is something I find genuinely energising.

One thing I did not mention before: I trained 12 colleagues on a new curriculum I wrote, which maps well to the onboarding work your team leads.

I would welcome the chance to discuss further.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor
